Two sessions, one clone (quorum r2, sol): simultaneous acceptance sessions within the same clone are prohibited; mine matches only this session's unique $W prefix and this clone's sim/ path (V33 two-clone drill); a mutation AC as a & job cannot trap INT (V30 negative control: the file stayed mutated). Foreground, one at a time.

The eye's margin is 0.55 m (V16): if a monitor frame grows by that much the eye is blocked again; the clear-eye check fails first and names the eye. Moving the eye or the furniture is the deck-layout row's call.

sky_hides mirrors _add_body_candidates (direction, skip id, distance; quorum r1 gemini non-blocking): product drift shows in AC6 as one failing without the other; the helper's comment names what it mirrors.

The pin fixture's state (quorum r1 gemini; V32): pin_destination leaves pinned_ids=[b], pin_fallbacks=1; the next set_custom_stars -> clear() resets both before 'absent metadata fails closed' runs. Coupling, not a defect.

The bounded runner's limits (V27-V30): the sim has its own process group, so the group kill misses it and reap catches it by its --package-dir <clone>/sim argv; a shell with INT ignored at start cannot trap INT (foreground only); a lone TERM to the AC shell runs the trap when the current bounded gate returns.
The fixture's vmag -14 has no physical meaning beyond brightness (~1 lux, as bright as the fixture rows' flux 1; vmag 0 is invisible at the fixture's exposure, V9).
